# FDG4044

> DO apply the `System.FlagsAttribute` to flag enums. Do not apply this attribute to simple enums.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 4.8.1 Designing Flag Enums.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1027, CA2217
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

CA1027 reports an enum whose values look like flags but that has no FlagsAttribute; CA2217 reports a FlagsAttribute enum whose values are not powers of two or combinations of other values. Both guess the kind of enum from its values. Their fixes add or remove FlagsAttribute, which changes what Enum.ToString and Enum.Parse return to callers, so the fix is treated as breaking. Noise: lowered to suggestion. On the noise samples one of the two CA1027 reports was a simple enum whose values happen to be 0 and 2 (1 false positive of 2). CA2217 stays a warning through FDG4045.

## From the book

```csharp
[Flags]
public enum AttributeTargets {
   ...
}
```
